text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the end of the year, as the Junior 
Class came to a close, a message arrived 
from the Three Goddesses. It was an 
invitation to the "Grow-Up Race"—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A stage where only talented Umamusume 
chosen by the Three Goddesses may compete. 
And <chrname> was about to step onto it as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To showcase the fruits of the three-legged 
race run by Umamusume and Trainer so far, 
the curtain rises on the decisive 
battle...!
